selection_rule: Before reading joint outcomes, fix the first128 assigned fit families, including early failures. Wait until every scoped joint-card leaf of that subset finishes; reject any missing/invalid/fault result. For each family, compute parent, relic-only hindsight, card-only hindsight under the parent relic, and joint hindsight using all legal scoped candidates, retaining relic branches with no card node at their source terminal. Select only families with parent=relic-only=card-only=0 and joint=1. In assigned-family order take at most the first4 distinct families; within each, take the first winning changed-relic/changed-card pair in frozen branch/candidate order. Record empty or unfilled slots without widening/replacement. Freeze selected paths and all subset source hashes before original execution.
verification: Independently reconstruct every scoped card root of selected families with the frozen native simulator and parent NN, audit every joint-card candidate in those families (including parent controls, all nonintervention NN choices, terminal/RNG/timer and Heart path). Reuse the current original-game natural-start comparator, then E83 recorded persistent-RNG and E84 command/scope/keys/Act3/Act4/cleanup checks. No mid-run state import, RNG assignment or resynchronization. Preserve every failure; confirmed gameplay/RNG differences block affected E89 labels.
resources: No new MCTS sampling pool or optimizer updates. Existing eight-worker E89 collection continues. One read-only selected-family audit process and at most one isolated original JVM at a time,900s per original case. Bounded dependency wait10800s; source pipeline liveness checked.
limits: Outcome-selected known-fit joint-only winning routes, maximum4 families from a fixed128-family subset. Does not cover all branches, losing routes, all combinations, learned strategy quality or a population win rate; does not replace the full E89 audit or final unseen1024 acceptance.

software_preflight.scope: Synthetic selection eligibility/order, failure rejection, no-card/early-failure accounting and zero-route driver behavior.
